title: github/v1
description: An installed GitHub App, at <root>/external/github/<app>; a runner App is github/runner-<tier>-<org>. Every field is a string. Adding a field is not breaking; removing, renaming or re-typing one is, and takes a new address, github.v2/<app>.

app_id.description: The App's id, as a string.

installation_id.description: The installation's id, as a string.
